name: Electronics and Controls for Textile Industry
description: Overview of electronics and controls in modern textile equipment and machines. Overview of basic analog electronics: elements (R, L, C, V, I), circuit laws and theorems, and operational amplifiers. Overview of basic digital electronics: logic gates and ICs; fundamentals of diodes, MOSFETs, and BJTs. Sensors and transducers (displacement, position, force, temperature, pressure, flow, humidity); sensors employed in the textile industry. Signal conditioning. Control elements, systems, and examples; applications of control systems in textiles. Data acquisition, analysis, control, and automation using microprocessors and microcontrollers; applications of data acquisition in textiles and case studies. Motors and power drives. Power control devices. Electronic textiles.
